resources.name: RoVista
quotes: In this paper, we present RoVista, an ROV measurement framework that leverages IP-ID side channel and in-the-wild RPKI-invalid prefix.

resources.name: RouteViews

Figure 1 (top) shows the portion of IP prefixes covered by at least one VRP from December 24th, 2021 to September 12th, 2023 captured at RouteViews [70].
references: [70] University of Oregon RouteViews project. http://www.routeviews.org/.

resources.name: UMich|ZMap
quotes: We then scan them using ZMap [ 26] to find tNodes that open popular TCP port numbers [ 68] so that we can send TCP SYN packets.
We use ZMap to obtain a set of vVP candidates, which respond to our TCP SYN/ACK scans with a RST packet so that we can track their IP-ID values.
